title: Documents from an approved design
description: Write the HLD + TDD (with an ERD) from a design that is already approved - the approved-design.md a previous run produced, or any design document you name. No re-design, no review loop: one pass over work that has already been signed off.

inputs.label: The approved design (paste it, and/or attach the file below)
Path to an approved design file to use as-is (e.g. .dhruva/runs/<run>/docs/approved-design.md) - leave blank to use the text above
